messages.author: 07dd458fe41a60e8
messages.subject: Error in bears_optim_run(BioGeoBEARS_run_object)
parts:
Hi Nick,

I am trying to run a DEC analysis with your example data but am running into the following error : 

Error in bears_optim_run(BioGeoBEARS_run_object) : 
  could not find function "detectCores"


I searched through your manual and tutorial but was unable to find the function "detectCores". Am I missing a library?

Thanks in advance for your time!

messages.author: 665b3d97beb30882
messages.subject: Re: [BioGeoBEARS] Error in bears_optim_run(BioGeoBEARS_run_object)
parts:
Hi,

try both of these:

library(parallel)
library(snow)

Depending on operating system and your version of R, one of these should solve the problem.

...cheers, Nick
